blocks.x: Smart Infrastructure, Buildings & Cities as delivered by Dataq Software: scope, delivery pattern, the platforms involved and the outcomes we commit to at each gate.

Buildings and infrastructure waste energy and attention at scale. We fuse building-management systems with IoT and analytics: unified telemetry across HVAC, lighting, meters, occupancy and equipment, analytics layers for fault detection and diagnostics (the 10-20% energy waste that BAS reports hide), occupancy-aware control policies, and portfolio dashboards for facility teams. Energy optimization ties into grid programs — demand-response participation, load-flexibility contracts and carbon reporting feeds.

At city and campus scale, the platform pattern applies: open data contracts across vendors, event fabric for mobility, lighting, safety and waste services, and privacy-by-design governance for anything touching citizens. Delivery emphasizes procurement realism — multi-vendor estates, legacy BMS protocols (BACnet, Modbus) translated into governed streams, and phased rollout by building class with measured savings before scale.

The engagement cadence below is the standard pattern for this capability. Weeks 1–2 lock the baseline: the current metric is measured with your team and signed before build starts. Weeks 3–8 deliver the pilot on bounded scope — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — with a control owner named on your side. Weeks 9–12 industrialize what worked: runbooks, monitoring, enablement and a measured delta against the signed baseline. Anything that misses its gate is stopped or redirected with a documented decision, not quietly extended.
